course_name: 遊戲式數位學習專題研究
outline: This course explores gamification and game-based learning in the AI era. In the first half, students use generative AI to design interactive gamified experiences; in the second, they develop and evaluate playable game-based learning experiences. The course emphasizes motivation, game mechanics, feedback, adaptation, and evaluation, with applications in education, workplace training, business, and other professional contexts.

flexible_learning.content:
Week 17: Online synchronous review and reflection on the final projects. Students analyze the strengths and limitations of their game design, learning objectives, game mechanics, AI use, and evaluation, and discuss possible improvements.
Week 18: Online synchronous learning on emerging AI-enhanced gamification and game-based learning, including adaptive games, AI characters, generative scenarios, personalized experiences, and their applications to students' own professional fields.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students will critically review their final projects, identify possible design improvements, and explain how emerging AI technologies may transform gamification and game-based learning. Students will also propose a potential application of AI-enhanced game-based learning in their own professional or real-world context. Learning outcomes will be evaluated through online participation, discussion, and a short reflection activity.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 5% – Online participation, final project reflection, and Week 18 learning activity.

Selected journal articles, case studies, and online resources related to gamification, game-based learning, and AI-enhanced learning will be provided through Google Classroom.

Students will also use generative AI and interactive development tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini Canvas, Claude Artifacts, and other emerging tools, for idea generation, prototyping, game development, and evaluation.

Recommended references:

Kapp, K. M. (2012). The Gamification of Learning and Instruction. Pfeiffer.
Chou, Y. K. (2015). Actionable Gamification: Beyond Points, Badges, and Leaderboards. Octalysis Media.
Selected recent SSCI journal articles on gamification, game-based learning, serious games, and AI-enhanced learning.
